_doc: Wording the onboarding command fills in for a new tenant (scripts/onboard/tenant.ts). NONE of this is approved for any tenant by being here: every sentence is written to canned_responses with reviewed_at NULL and the founder signs each tenant's lines on that tenant's wording sheet. `derived_from` says which already-approved line a template was made from and what changed, so the reading is quick. Placeholders: {phones} (the client's phones, joined with « эсвэл »), {booking_url}, {business} (the business name from 1.1). A variant key is a tenants.vertical value; `default` is used for every other vertical. `approved_bytes: true` marks a template whose filled text is byte-identical to a line the founder already approved for a live tenant. Every template here was read and approved AS A TEMPLATE by the founder on 2026-09-27 (`template_approved`); each client's filled lines are still signed on that client's wording sheet.

verticals._doc: How 1.2 «Үйл ажиллагааны чиглэл» picks tenants.vertical. The first vertical with a stem that begins a word of the answer wins; no match is `general`, which is reported. Override with --vertical.

client_summary._doc: Headings of the one-page facts summary sent to the CLIENT to confirm (gate 2). Not a bot sentence; the founder reads it once as a template. Everything under the headings is the client's own data as the database now holds it.
client_summary.title: Дали-д оруулсан мэдээлэл — баталгаажуулах хуудас
